scope: 客户端无服务端依赖下的 JSON 备份导出（Blob 机制）与文件读取导入（FileReader）官方规范
content: File API W3C Working Draft. A Blob interface, which represents immutable raw binary data. A File interface. A FileReader interface, which provides methods to read a File or a Blob, and an event model to obtain the results of these reads. A URL scheme for use with binary data such as files.
